source: Prototype education-only credit-readiness rules; not a credit bureau, loan decision, or financial advice.
what_lenders_check: Cash flow and ability to repay
alternatives: Discuss microfinance options and total borrowing cost

strong: 30 days: retain bank statements and invoices.
60 days: compare lender terms, including all charges.
90 days: prepare a simple cash-flow record.
fair: 30 days: pay every existing obligation on time.
60 days: avoid unnecessary new credit applications.
thin_file: 30 days: open or actively use a bank account for business cash flows.
60 days: keep invoices and income records.
90 days: explore SHG or co-applicant routes if appropriate.
needs_repair: 30 days: review and clear overdue amounts where possible.
90 days: obtain guidance before taking additional debt.
